candidates.exact_span: Input pollutant geometric mean concentration as micro-gram per liter (ug/l or ppb) unless other unit is specified for the parameter.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Different readings of whether a parameter's units are ug/l/ppb or an unspecified alternate unit would change the numeric limit used for compliance comparison against reported measurements.

candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) but the DL is greater than MQL, input "1/2 DL" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether and how a below-detection effluent value is converted to 1/2 DL versus treated as non-numeric/no-data changes the effluent concentration used in limit comparisons and the established missing-evidence state for that measurement period.

candidates.exact_span: Effluent value reported as "< detection level" (DL) and the DL is smaller than MQL, no data is inputted.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of the DL-versus-MQL threshold determines whether an effluent value is excluded from numeric comparison entirely, affecting both applicable-limit evaluation and classification of the period as documented no-data versus analyzable.

candidates.exact_span: If a less than MQL vakue is reported, input either the reported value or "0" for calculation.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Ambiguity over whether to substitute zero or retain the reported below-MQL value changes computed concentrations for limit exceedance checks and whether the evidence is treated as a numeric result or a qualified no-data state.
Different interpretation of the instream waste concentration formula and its inputs yields a different computed concentration that may be compared against water quality or discharge criteria.

candidates.exact_span: F    = Fraction of stream allowed for mixing (see "Procedures for Implementing NPDES Permits in New Mexico")
candidates.computation_change_reason: The applicable mixing fraction F is not fixed in this segment; resolving it from external procedures changes Cd and therefore which numeric limit comparison result applies.

candidates.exact_span: Qa = Critical low flow of stream at discharge point expressed as the 4Q3 or harmonic mean flow for human health criteria
candidates.computation_change_reason: Choice between 4Q3 and harmonic mean flow for Qa alters Cd and downstream limit-exceedance determinations for human-health-based criteria.

candidates.exact_span: The following formular convert metals reported in total form to dissolved form if criteria are in dissolved form
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether total-reported metals must be converted to dissolved form before comparison determines which numeric criterion form is enforceable for a given parameter.
Interpretation of the partition coefficient formula and its inputs changes the dissolved-fraction conversion applied to total metal measurements before limit comparison.
Different readings of TSS source or scaling in the dissolved-fraction denominator change the converted dissolved criteria value used in compliance evaluation.
How Cr and C/Ct are resolved from reported data determines the enforceable total-metal numeric limit against which measurements are compared.

candidates.exact_span: TSS = Total suspended solids concentration found in receiving stream (or in effluent for intermittent stream)
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether TSS is taken from the receiving stream or effluent depends on intermittent-stream classification, changing dissolved-metal limit conversion and whether effluent TSS monitoring conditions are operative.
The tabulated Kpo, alpha, Kp, C/Ct, and dissolved values for copper govern conversion between total and dissolved forms; misreading any coefficient changes the applicable numeric limit for copper.

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 750 in cell O113
candidates.computation_change_reason: Conditional substitution of a fixed acute aluminum criterion when stream pH is below 6.5 changes the enforceable numeric limit applied instead of the hardness-derived formula result.

candidates.exact_span: If Stream pH < 6.5, enter 87 in cell P113
candidates.computation_change_reason: Conditional substitution of a fixed chronic aluminum criterion when stream pH is below 6.5 changes the enforceable numeric limit applied instead of the hardness-derived formula result.
Interpretation of the cadmium acute hardness-correction factor CF1 changes the computed acute criterion value used for limit comparison.
Interpretation of the cadmium chronic hardness-correction factor CF2 changes the computed chronic criterion value used for limit comparison.
